body:
## Why

Merged PR #63 added the fork-token fallback in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml:1190-1206` and the executable regression harness in `tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py:250-307`. The implementation is present on current `main`, but the merged diff contains no durable literal transcript proving that the named test fails when only `readOnlyForkToken` is disabled and passes again after exact restoration. This is a verified delivery-evidence gap, not a new Gate behavior defect.

## Scope

Replay the deliberate break against current `main`, restore the workflow exactly, and add a documentation-only evidence record at `docs/evidence/issue-65-pr-63-deliberate-break.md`.

## Non-Goals

- Do not change the fork-tolerance implementation in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` or the assertions in `tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py`.
- Do not reconstruct historical output from PR #63; label the transcript as a fresh current-`main` replay.
- Scaffold-only or partial completion does not count: a green run without the deliberate RED output, exact restoration, and clean-path proof fails this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] In `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml:1194-1195`, temporarily replace only the `readOnlyForkToken` predicate with `false`; run `uv run pytest -q tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py --no-cov` and capture the literal failing output.
- [ ] Restore `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` exactly; rerun `uv run pytest -q tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py --no-cov` and capture the literal passing output.
- [ ] Add the exact commands, RED/GREEN output, current-main base SHA, and restoration checks to `docs/evidence/issue-65-pr-63-deliberate-break.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With only the `readOnlyForkToken` predicate in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml:1194-1195` replaced by `false`, `uv run pytest -q tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py --no-cov` exits nonzero and names the fork and deleted-fork expectations; `docs/evidence/issue-65-pr-63-deliberate-break.md` records the literal command and output.
- [ ] After exact restoration, `uv run pytest -q tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py --no-cov` exits 0 and `docs/evidence/issue-65-pr-63-deliberate-break.md` records the literal passing output.
- [ ] After restoration, `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- .github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py` exits 0 with no output, and `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` exits 0 before push.

## Implementation Notes

This is a fresh replay on current `main`, not a reconstruction of historical command output. Only `docs/evidence/issue-65-pr-63-deliberate-break.md` should remain in the closing PR diff.
